items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: The drummer... was clay bad. His name is Keglin Eddie's brother.

ctx.x: Leon Loron. He's still old guitar player there with him. And then Ralph used to play violin with my dad. His brother Ralph Loron used to play violin with my daddy. He was a great violinist too. Baye, you know. He played both the same thing. And the drummer, the drummer I tell you was playing with him was clay bad. Little clay bad. His name is Keglin Eddie's brother. He's dead now. He's late clay bad. Well that was they lined up. And they had a fine band. Normally they play all those old moments such as the Tiger,…
Did they work over there very often?
